statement: Nvidia is described as accounting for as much as 90% of AI chip market share in any given quarter, leaving AMD as a small share challenger.
why: It sets the baseline the entire AMD story is measured against: even a doubling of AMD's data center revenue moves share only modestly from this starting point.

impact.mechanism: Extreme incumbent concentration means accelerator supply and pricing remain set by one vendor until a challenger's ramp is large enough to shift share.

evidence.excerpt: dominates the AI chip space, accounting for as much as 90% of market share in any given quarter

confidence.basis: Loosely worded journalistic characterization ('as much as') in one secondary article, with no methodology or period stated.
